svg.text: Jetson Nano battery monitor — pin wiring
Follow the colored lines. Colors are suggested. A crossing without a dot does not connect.
Pack voltage stays on the violet wires. It never lands on a header pin. Red pack + is not orange 3.3 V.
Dashed gray, ending in X: USB–I2C alternate. Do not connect it and pins 3 and 5 together.
1 Power, left to right. Arrow is discharge current.
GND: load −, charger −, buck IN−, J25 sleeve
J25 is the only 5 V into the Jetson.
Not both. Header 5 V is not this supply.
2 Sense. Violet is pack voltage. These wires are not the load current.
F3 = 100 mA, at the shunt end of each wire.
F3 voltage rating is still open.
10 Ω next to the INA. 100 Ω on VBUS only.
VBUS is tapped at P+, the battery side.
The resistors do not replace F3.
Strap A1 and A0 to this GND pin.
VIN is chip VS. ALRT (ALERT) stays open.
VIN from pin 1 only. Never 5 V.
Strap ADD0 to this GND pin.
V+ from pin 1. ALERT is not used.
Pack temperature, not the INA die.
Four pins: GND, VCC, SDA, SCL.
Drawn at 3.3 V from pin 1. No shifter.
Only if the LCD backpack is 5 V
Do not tie VCC to pin 1. Power VCC from 5 V.
BSS138 shifter on SDA and SCL only (NXP AN10441).
Low side 3.3 V, high side 5 V. INA228 and TMP117 stay on 3.3 V.
Short cable. No extra pull-up. Not a 5 V USB-serial.
Logger GND to pin 6, or to pin 9 if pin 6 is already used.
Pins 2 and 4 = 5 V. Do not feed them.
Pins 27 and 28: other I2C. Leave them if a camera is fitted.
Signals are 3.3 V. Unlisted pins are unused here.
USB cable → Jetson J32 or J33.
Adapter SDA, SCL, and GND, at 3.3 V.
Do not connect both this and pins 3 and 5.
3 Pod wall. Three slots. Pack current, F1, F2, the buck, and J25 do not enter.
This is the link to the Jetson header.
UART alone does not run the LCD or the INA228.
3.3 V, GND, SDA, and SCL have to be in this jacket.
Keep it short. The TX pin is a weak driver.
TMP117 stays on the pack and joins this
bus at the Jetson, not inside the pod.
F3 on each wire, at the shunt.
10 Ω on IN+ and 100 Ω on VBUS
sit next to the INA, in the pod.
F3 on IN−, at the shunt.
10 Ω next to the INA, in the pod.
USB–I2C board is in the pod and has no slot. Leave it unwired, or add a USB lead and take SDA and SCL out of the UART cable. Do not connect both.
Sources: NVIDIA Jetson Nano Developer Kit User Guide DA_09402, connector J41. Pins 3 and 5, and 27 and 28, are I2C. Pins 8 and 10 are UART TX and RX. Signals are 3.3 V.
Pin 1 = 3.3 V, pins 2 and 4 = 5 V, pins 6 and 9 = GND, as in battery/README.md and the J41 header map. On the module, I2C_2 is pins 3 and 5. Wire the pin numbers.
Editable source: battery/wiring/draw_wiring.py and battery/wiring/battery_monitor_wiring.svg. Colors on this figure are suggested.
